title: Rename: an attribute, keeping its column
prompt: Rename CatalogItem.AvailableStock to StockOnHand throughout the code. Keep the database column name as it is.
done: CatalogItem.AvailableStock is StockOnHand everywhere in the code and its column is still named AvailableStock

expect.text: The Domain designer's StockOnHand is the AvailableStock attribute renamed in place, not a new attribute.
The column name AvailableStock is kept, in the code (HasColumnName or [Column]) and in the model.
